app_fee.value: The application fee for international applicants is $85, non-refundable; the figure is on the Physics page, which says the Graduate School administers applications.
app_fee.quote: A $75 non-refundable processing fee is required for domestic applications ($85 for international)

fee_waiver.value: OSU does not offer application fee waivers to international students. Some departments run their own waivers (see Chemistry and Materials).
fee_waiver.quote: OSU does not have application fee waivers for international students.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School leaves GRE requirements to individual graduate programs.
gre_general.quote: Individual graduate programs may require additional documents such as GRE and GMAT test results or set higher English and academic standards.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 minimum for regular admission (sub-score of 18 on each section); GTA requires speaking 22.

ielts_min.value: IELTS 6.5 minimum for regular admission; GTA requires speaking 7.0.

english_waiver.value: The waiver list specifies exempt countries (US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, etc.) and does not include India.
english_waiver.quote: The English language proficiency requirement is waived for applicants who hold either citizenship or a baccalaureate or graduate degree from a recognized or accredited institution in any of the following countries: Anguilla, Antigua and Barbuda, Australia, The Bahamas, Barbados, Belize, Bermuda, British Overseas Territories, British Virgin Islands, Botswana, Cameroon, Canada, Cayman Islands, Dominica, Eswatini, Fiji, The Gambia, Ghana, Grenada, Guyana, Ireland, Jamaica, Kenya, Kiribati, Lesotho, Liberia, Malawi, Montserrat, Namibia, Nigeria, New Zealand, Rwanda, Saint Lucia, Saint Kitts and Nevis, Saint Vincent and the Grenadines, Sierra Leone, Singapore, South Africa, Tanzania, Tonga, Trinidad and Tobago, Turks and Caicos Islands, Uganda, United Kingdom, Zambia, Zimbabwe.

notes: The international page's regular-admission minimums (TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6.5) are table cells; the quotes are the single cells. The page's country list is the only English-waiver text; the India entry on the country-specific page is a bare name with no rule text, even after rendering.
